BUYER REPRESENTATION AGREEMENT

This Buyer Representation Agreement (this "Agreement") is entered into as of June 1, 2026 (the "Effective Date") between Marlow Realty Group LLC, a licensed real estate broker ("Broker"), and Dana Okafor ("Buyer").

1. Appointment. Buyer appoints Broker as Buyer's agent for the purchase of residential real property in Travis County, Texas (the "Market Area"). This Agreement is exclusive: during its term Buyer will work only with Broker to buy a home in the Market Area. Broker represents Buyer as Buyer's agent.

2. Services. Broker will provide the following services: locating and showing properties that meet Buyer's criteria; advising Buyer on price and terms; preparing and presenting Buyer's offers; negotiating on Buyer's behalf; and coordinating inspections, financing deadlines and the closing.

3. Term. This Agreement begins on the Effective Date and ends on November 30, 2026. Either party may end it earlier on ten days' written notice. If Buyer is under contract to buy a property when the Agreement would end, it continues for that purchase until closing.

4. Broker's Compensation. Broker's compensation is 2.5% of the purchase price of the property Buyer buys, earned when Buyer closes on a property in the Market Area during the term and payable at closing. Broker will first ask the seller or the listing broker to pay it. Buyer will pay only the part, if any, that the seller and the listing broker do not pay.

5. No Compensation Above This Amount. Broker may not receive compensation for its services from any source that exceeds the amount stated in Section 4. If the seller or the listing broker offers more, Broker will not accept the excess.

6. BROKER COMPENSATION IS NOT SET BY LAW AND IS FULLY NEGOTIABLE.

7. Protection Period. Buyer will owe the compensation in Section 4 if, within 60 days after this Agreement ends, Buyer contracts to buy a property that Broker showed Buyer during the term, unless Buyer has by then signed a representation agreement with another broker.

8. Other Buyers. Broker may represent other buyers who are interested in the same properties, and will not disclose one buyer's offer terms to another.

9. Default. If either party breaches this Agreement and does not cure the breach within ten days after written notice, the other party may terminate it. On termination, Buyer will pay any compensation already earned under Section 4, and Sections 5, 7 and 10 continue to apply.

10. General. This Agreement is governed by the laws of the State of Texas, and the state courts located in Travis County, Texas have exclusive jurisdiction over any dispute arising under it. This Agreement is the entire agreement of the parties and may be amended only in a writing signed by both parties.

MARLOW REALTY GROUP LLC

By: ______________________
Name: Renee Marlow
Title: Broker of Record
